CustomField.description: OMNI-70733 - Ad-targeting keyword embedded in the lead etag (e.g. T5, Tall, Tcs). Matched case-insensitively as "-<tag>-" against the etag; longer keyword wins on overlap. Tags exist only as data here — never hard-coded.
